$description: Global Fellowship Proposed Brand Candidate Design Tokens (Living Nearness v15.0, W3C DTCG 2025.10 canonical single source of truth). Preserves Global Fellowship's established Cross-in-Oval logo silhouette (140:101) while introducing a proposed culturally neutral editorial palette (Harbor Teal, Kiln Clay, Candle Apricot, Warm Paper & Charcoal Ink; regional review pending under OVR-11) paired with vetted non-ShareAlike documentary street photography. Website preview sync (src/app/globals.css) is paused under OVR-24 pending explicit human brand approval (OVR-15).

metadata.markSilhouettePolicy: Explicitly established: preserve Global Fellowship's official Cross-in-Oval logo silhouette (140:101); colors, typography, and graphic language chosen under the 2026-11-22 Color Freedom directive.

legacyColorEvolution.retiredLegacyBlue: Replaced legacy #007AC3 and draft Cobalt (#173FA8/#0F2566) with Harbor Teal (#0C525C) and Harbor Night (#0B272E), chosen to avoid specified corporate and regional flag combinations (actual local associations assessed by regional reviewers under OVR-11, with Ink-Neutral fallback available anytime).
legacyColorEvolution.retiredLegacyYellow: Replaced legacy #FFE11D and draft Sunburst Gold (#F2B705/#9E6600) with Kiln Clay (#7E3119, 2 Cor 4:7 earthenware warmth, AAA directly on paper) and Candle Apricot (#F2B488 on dark), designed to avoid light-ground ochre drift and specified regional flag pairings (pending OVR-11 regional review).
legacyColorEvolution.legacyWhite: Replaced stark #FFFFFF with Warm Paper (#FAF7F2) and Pure White (#FFFFFF) for copier stock

metadata.wcagFloor: WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA full-precision verified across all light, dark, and semantic-scope token pairs including deuteranopia >= 4.5:1 text and >= 3.0:1 non-text
